paper_core_claims.claim: Classical refinement verification conditions are unsound for lazy evaluation because they may assume refinements of free variables bound to divergent expressions.
Div, Wnf and Fin strata distinguish computations that may diverge, reduce to a value, or reduce to a finite value, so only sound environmental refinements enter SMT conditions.
The algorithmic lambda-D system restricts predicates to QF-EUFLIAD, uses stratified fixpoint constants, and soundly approximates evaluation-based implication with decidable SMT validity.
The proven guarantee is type preservation and crash-freedom; unlabelled refinement types retain partial correctness and do not require termination.
On 10,202 lines across 39 library modules, LiquidHaskell proves 483 of 503 recursive functions terminating, with 173 explicit hints and 1,880 seconds total verification time on the reported machine.

function_concept_used_by_paper: A Haskell function is specified by a base type refined with decidable predicates and an evaluation stratum. Type checking compiles subtyping and termination obligations into SMT verification conditions, and successful discharge yields a proof-backed executable artifact under the formal calculus and assumptions.
representation_or_carrier: The main carriers are refinement types, dependent function contracts, Div/Wnf/Fin labels, environments, measures, qualifiers, decreasing metrics, verification conditions and typed Core-like expressions. Labels encode a nontermination effect that controls which propositions are logically admissible; they are not runtime probability or metadata tags.
specification_language: Refined base and function types express preconditions, postconditions, data invariants and termination metrics using equality, uninterpreted functions, linear integer arithmetic and algebraic datatypes. The language deliberately excludes arbitrary program terms from refinements. It is precise for the modeled pure Haskell core, but does not specify operational effects, resource bounds, concurrency, external calls, deployment provenance or lifecycle policy.
compiler_or_generator: LiquidHaskell translates Haskell/GHC Core plus refinements and qualifiers into stratified types, inferred refinements and decidable SMT verification conditions. Recursive functions use terminating fixpoint encodings with default, explicit, lexicographic or datatype-size metrics; deliberately nonterminating definitions can be marked lazy so their refinements are omitted from assumptions.
interpreter_or_runtime: Verified code executes with ordinary lazy Haskell call-by-need semantics. The soundness result connects the calculus's reductions to type preservation and absence of the modeled crash term; the SMT solver is a compile-time validator, not a runtime interpreter or monitor.
composition_rule: Function composition uses ordinary typed application and lets output refinements instantiate downstream input obligations. Environment composition is evaluation-sensitive: facts from Div bindings are erased from the VC, while Wnf/Fin bindings contribute predicates. This is a formal specification/validation composition rule, not weight-space or learned-function merging.
state_or_effect_model: The formal effect tracked is possible nontermination, represented by stratification and weakened environments. Pattern matching supplies WHNF evidence; termination proofs supply Fin evidence. The work models pure functional reduction and crash-freedom, not mutable state, I/O, exceptions beyond the abstract crash, concurrency, probabilistic effects, authorization or artifact lifecycle.
uncertainty_model: The formal judgment is categorical and proof-theoretic: an SMT obligation is valid or rejected, subject to the encoding and solver. There is no probabilistic confidence. Empirical counts report one corpus and machine without repeated runs or confidence intervals; they measure proof coverage and annotation burden, not the probability that arbitrary programs are correct. An UNSAFE result may be code or specification error and is not a calibrated defect probability.

validation_regime.formal: denotational typing, preservation, progress, crash-freedom, fixpoint typing, lifting and equivalence theorems with extended proofs
validation_regime.implementation: LiquidHaskell inputs source, refinements and qualifiers and returns SAFE/UNSAFE plus inferred subexpression types
validation_regime.scale: 39 modules, 10,202 non-comment LOC, 1,539 functions, 503 recursive functions
validation_regime.reported_results: 20 marked potentially nonterminating, 173 termination hints, 96.0% of recursive functions proven terminating, 1.7 hints per 100 LOC, 1,880 seconds
validation_regime.boundary: The evaluation is a selected 2014 Haskell library corpus and does not independently validate every theorem, modern GHC behavior, effects or arbitrary applications.

equivalence_notions.boundary: Implication is relative to the restricted logic, type environment and evaluation stratum.
Failure to prove termination is not proof of divergence; some deliberate divergence is labeled Div.
The theorem excludes the calculus's crash state, not all real-world failures, side effects or specification mistakes.

lifecycle_and_provenance: The study records a formal calculus, implementation name, corpus modules, counts, hardware and timing, but the retrieved report does not pin the exact LiquidHaskell source revision, GHC/SMT versions, corpus commits, proof scripts or machine-readable result ledger. There is no artifact manifest, signature, approval, continuous revalidation, compatibility migration, rollback, supersession or retirement model. Verification results can become stale when source, specs, compiler or solver changes.
limitations_and_failure_boundaries: The authors explicitly note that safety proofs can lose precision merely by adding nondeterministic divergence, because the practical solution relies on proving termination to admit refinements.
The guarantee is relative to the specified refinements; incorrect or incomplete specifications can still describe unwanted behavior as safe.
Unlabelled refinements establish partial correctness and crash-freedom, not total correctness or termination.
The decidable QF-EUFLIAD fragment excludes arbitrary functions and many semantic properties; qualifiers and measures constrain inference expressiveness.
Pattern, termination and finiteness reasoning target a pure lazy core and do not constitute a general algebraic effect, I/O, exception, concurrency or distributed-state system.
SAFE/UNSAFE is not probabilistic confidence, and an unproved obligation is not proof that the program fails.
The empirical 96% result is corpus-specific and selected; it has no repeated-run uncertainty or independent replication in this paper.
The technical report does not pin a reproducible paper-era implementation or all dependency/corpus versions.
Modern LiquidHaskell and GHC behavior cannot be inferred as identical to the 2014 artifact without a separate current audit.
what_the_paper_does_not_support: It does not prove arbitrary Haskell programs, effects or specifications correct.
It does not turn failed verification into a calibrated bug diagnosis.
It does not supply runtime enforcement, probabilistic semantics, learned-function composition or registry lifecycle governance.
It does not validate the full Function OS architecture or empirical behavior outside its formal model.

corrections: The ICFP 2014 DOI, five authors and exact technical-report identity were recorded.
The lazy unsoundness counterexample, partial-correctness denotation and Div/Wnf/Fin distinction were separated explicitly.
The lambda-U/lambda-D soundness chain and its decidable-logic boundary were reviewed through the supplement.
Exact corpus counts, proof coverage, annotation burden, timing and reproducibility limitations were recorded.

confirmed_projection: The paper gives direct formal and implementation-backed support for a rich FunctionSpec, formal Representation, VC Compiler, proof-backed Artifact, lazy Interpreter semantics and Validator. It also supplies a bounded composition discipline through typed application and evaluation-sensitive fact flow. Runtime traces, probabilistic uncertainty and VersionedRegistry lifecycle remain partial.
source_specific_reasoning: CONFIRMED is warranted within the formal model: the paper does not merely propose refinements but derives the lazy-evaluation failure, defines declarative and decidable calculi, proves preservation and crash-freedom, implements the approach and measures it on 10,202 library lines. The important boundary is that refinement types express partial correctness unless termination is separately established, and safety is only as complete as the specification and modeled effects. The 96% figure is proof coverage in one corpus, not an empirical probability of correctness.
projection_boundary: These are 121CX projections from the exact 23-page ICFP technical report and primary publication metadata. The formal guarantees are theorem-backed within the paper's calculus; the implementation results are empirical and not independently rerun. This is not proof of all Haskell effects, modern toolchains or the complete Function OS, and not a final truth freeze.
